Yazı, Grossi'nin olası liderliğinin küresel teşkilatın siyasi yönünü nasıl etkileyeceğini tartışıyor.
haberler.ozet_en: International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Grossi has put forward his candidacy for United Nations secretary-general. According to an analysis published on the Al Jazeera website, Grossi faces criticism over his close relations with US President Donald Trump and Argentine President Javier Milei. The author notes that the reforms proposed by Grossi align with the agendas of these two leaders, raising questions about the agency's independence. With several candidates having withdrawn, eight contenders remain in the race, with Rebeca Grynspan, head of the UN Conference on Trade and Development, emerging as another prominent figure. The article discusses how Grossi's potential leadership could affect the political direction of the global organization.

Ekim 2023 tarihinden bu yana Gazze Şeridi ve güney Lübnan'daki nüfusun yoğun olduğu bölgelerde beyaz fosfor gibi yangın çıkarıcı silahların kullanılmasını gerekçe gösteren kuruluşlar ortak bildiri yayımladı. haberler.ozet_en: Eleven human rights and non-governmental organizations, including Human Rights Watch and Amnesty International, called on governments to strengthen international restrictions. The organizations issued a joint statement citing the use of incendiary weapons such as white phosphorus in densely populated areas in the Gaza Strip and southern Lebanon since October 2023. Human Rights Watch verified twenty-three incidents of Israeli forces using white phosphorus in southern Lebanon between March and May 2026. These incidents included airbursts over residential areas that were indiscriminate in nature and violated international humanitarian law.
